description: Composition of ACRV1 stalk vs LU domain, functional heterogeneity of structural neighbours, and domain map with the mAb epitope
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, collections
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
seq=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P26436.fasta",timeout=60).text.split('\n',1)[1].replace('\n','')
stalk=seq[21:185]; lu=seq[185:265]
def props(s,name):
    neg=sum(s.count(c) for c in 'DE'); pos=sum(s.count(c) for c in 'KR')
    hyd=sum(s.count(c) for c in 'AVLIMFWYC')
    print(f"{name:26s} L={len(s):3d}  D+E={neg:3d} ({100*neg/len(s):4.1f}%)  K+R={pos:2d} ({100*pos/len(s):4.1f}%)  net={pos-neg:+4d}  hydrophobic={100*hyd/len(s):4.1f}%  Cys={s.count('C')}  S+T+G+P+Q={100*sum(s.count(c) for c in 'STGPQ')/len(s):4.1f}%")
print("=== composition ===")
props(stalk,"stalk 22-185"); props(lu,"LU domain 186-265")
print("\nC-terminal 25 aa:", seq[-25:])
print("No GPI omega-site / hydrophobic C-terminal tail: last 25 aa hydrophobicity = %.1f%% (GPI signals are >60%% hydrophobic over ~20 aa)"
      % (100*sum(seq[-25:].count(c) for c in 'AVLIMFW')/25))

# --- Foldseek PDB hits grouped by what the homolog actually does ---
fs=S.get("https://search.foldseek.com/api/result/yXBid0PUXggiyh_CgkcU8h_2_2K-7mKqCsythw/0",timeout=240).json()
pdb=[a for r in fs['results'] if r['db']=='pdb100' for a in (r['alignments'][0] if isinstance(r['alignments'][0],list) else r['alignments'])]
cls={'uPAR':'protease receptor (uPAR/PLAUR)','urokinase':'protease receptor (uPAR/PLAUR)',
 'GPIHBP1':'lipase transporter (GPIHBP1)','Lipoprotein Lipase':'lipase transporter (GPIHBP1)',
 'C4.4A':'LU cell-surface protein (C4.4A, LYPD6B)','Lypd6':'LU cell-surface protein (C4.4A, LYPD6B)',
 'TEX101':'sperm/testis LU protein (TEX101)',
 'neurotox':'snake three-finger toxin','ERABUTOXIN':'snake three-finger toxin','Erabutoxin':'snake three-finger toxin',
 'irditoxin':'snake three-finger toxin','muscarinic toxin':'snake three-finger toxin','neurotoxin':'snake three-finger toxin',
 'TGF-b':'TGF-beta/BMP receptor ectodomain','Transforming Growth Factor':'TGF-beta/BMP receptor ectodomain',
 'BMP':'TGF-beta/BMP receptor ectodomain','GDF':'TGF-beta/BMP receptor ectodomain','ActRII':'TGF-beta/BMP receptor ectodomain',
 'Wnt':'LU protein in Wnt signalling','nicotinic':'snake three-finger toxin','acetylcholine':'snake three-finger toxin'}
cnt=collections.Counter()
for a in pdb:
    for k,v in cls.items():
        if k.lower() in a['target'].lower(): cnt[v]+=1; break
    else: cnt['other / unclassified']+=1
print("\n=== functional classes among 99 PDB100 structural neighbours of ACRV1 186-265 ===")
for k,v in cnt.most_common(): print(f"  {v:3d}  {k}")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,5.2))
ax=axes[0]
k=[x for x,_ in cnt.most_common()][::-1]; v=[cnt[x] for x in k]
colors=['#c9ced4' if x=='other / unclassified' else '#2a6f97' for x in k]
ax.barh(range(len(k)),v,color=colors)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(k))); ax.set_yticklabels(k,fontsize=9)
for i,val in enumerate(v): ax.text(val+0.6,i,str(val),va='center',fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xlabel('number of PDB100 Foldseek hits (n = 99)')
ax.set_title('The LU fold is one scaffold used for many functions,\nso fold alone does not name a molecular function',fontsize=10.5)
ax.set_xlim(0,max(v)*1.22)

ax=axes[1]
segs=[('signal peptide',1,21,'#e9c46a'),('disordered Ser/Glu repeat stalk',22,185,'#f4a261'),('LU three-finger domain',186,265,'#2a6f97')]
for n,a,b,c in segs:
    ax.barh(0,b-a+1,left=a,height=.45,color=c,edgecolor='white')
    ax.text((a+b)/2,0,n if b-a>40 else '',ha='center',va='center',fontsize=9,color='white' if c=='#2a6f97' else '#3a2d14')
ax.text(11,.38,'signal\npeptide',ha='center',fontsize=8)
for c in [190,193,202,209,217,235,239,255,256,262]:
    ax.plot(c,-.30,marker='^',ms=6,color='#bb3e03')
ax.text(226,-.46,'10 Cys / 5 disulfides, ends CCRNQSFCN',ha='center',fontsize=8.5,color='#bb3e03')
ax.plot([135,149],[.34,.34],lw=5,color='#6a040f',solid_capstyle='butt')
ax.text(142,.46,'epitope 135-149 of mAb pep-SP10 (PMID 10775167)\nblocks sperm-oolemma binding: lies in the disordered\nstalk, not in the LU domain',ha='center',fontsize=8,color='#6a040f')
ax.annotate('Pfam PF00021 u-PAR/Ly-6\n188-264',xy=(226,-.16),ha='center',fontsize=8,color='#14425e')
ax.set_xlim(0,272); ax.set_ylim(-.72,.78); ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlabel('residue in P26436')
ax.set_title('Domain map of human ACRV1 / SP-10 (265 aa)',fontsize=10.5)
for s in ['top','right','left']: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
